oracle: A process-wide /proc/self/task scan for comm eval-bot-vad, strict equality of sorted (tid,starttime); scan errors remain None and fail equality on Linux.
baseline_timing: Fixture::with_config obtains baseline before analyzer/model creation and before session.run starts BotTranscription; baseline can contain another concurrently running case's worker.
native_ownership: BotTranscription::finish signals stop, takes native JoinHandle and calls join; request_stop is distinct from join. The per-fixture finish awaits its run and peer tasks before observing /proc. Native join itself has no wall-time guarantee.
default_parallel_issue: Other case workers entering or leaving the global set can break equality even if the current case joined its owned worker. Nonempty baseline -> empty final is not a surviving native-thread observation.
http_closed_semantics: Successful reply writes/shuts down stream and sets replied=true; closed is set only by expected EOF/reset/broken-pipe disconnect branches. A joined successful HTTP peer with replied=true/closed=false is not by itself failure.
candidate_a: Static async Mutex<()> local to this integration binary; first-line async guard in all 14 async test entrypoints, first-line blocking_lock in invalid_bounds sync #[test]. Ordinary constructor test unchanged. All original contents/assertions/timeouts remain.
candidate_a_precondition: Wait for original raw to separate nonempty baseline, foreign after set, None snapshot, and any independent behavioural failure before assigning observed causes.
candidate_b_tradeoff: A cohort read-lease + quiescent writer would need a different stable cohort baseline and lifecycle/admission proof. It is larger than enforcing the existing explicit exclusivity assumption.
cancellation_drop_nested_review: All model/peer work remains independent of the test lock. Explicit future-drop aborts only the session task and then calls finish before checks. Loop cases finish+checked before next Fixture. Absence wrappers own one lock and helper takes none. No current test holds two simultaneous Fixtures.
scanner_error_limit: comm is read before name filtering: any non-NotFound comm error (including a non-VAD task) yields None. NotFound is already skipped; stat is read only for matching native names. entry errors and parse errors also lose detail. Existing None alone cannot identify errno or prove leak/cleanup.
unchanged: No source or runtime changes; no case execution; no tolerance/observation-window/test-thread arguments relaxed.

mutex_primary_source.scope: blocking_lock supports sharing a Mutex between synchronous and asynchronous code; it panics within an async execution context. Original invalid_bounds remains a synchronous Rust #[test] with no Runtime::enter or asynchronous caller.

log_availability_limit: All 14 asynchronous cases print Outcome snapshots before their assertion; invalid_bounds only prints the failed condition and may not have recoverable original before/after values.
